Canadian Space Agency on Instagram: "How big is the Orion spacecraft that will bring four astronauts to the Moon during Artemis II? Its habitable volume is 9 m3. That is like living in a campervan with three of your friends! 🚀

Artemis II is a test flight to help prepare for future lunar missions. Aboard Orion, the crew will test the systems and procedures, but also refine techniques for everything that pertains to life in space: eating, sleeping, staying clean, exercising, and communicating with the ground."
